tools.name: trickest_developer_endpoints
tools.description: Get the canonical Trickest developer endpoints and how to authenticate: REST API base URL, OpenAPI spec URL, hosted MCP endpoints and the Authorization header, CLI install command, SDK package, and where to create an API token. Returns the site's own /developers/llms.txt index.

tools.name: trickest_find_page
tools.description: Search trickest.com for the page that answers a question: docs, API reference, workflow library entries, security tools, modules, glossary terms. Returns matching titles, absolute URLs and one-line summaries from the site's published /llms.txt index.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. 'api reference pagination' or 'nuclei workflow'. Every word must appear in the entry.
